agent.problem: Cards 2, 6, 8, 9 and 12 require facts that cannot be reasoned out from the earlier cards: the sons' ministry, what Jeduthun says while playing, how Heman received his sons, and two exact totals. That makes most of the stop's eight choice cards discovery questions rather than informed guesses.

rule.text: A few discovery questions are fine. Some moments can't be reasoned out, like where Jonah's ship is headed. A few of those are okay, as long as most choice cards are informed guesses.

agent.problem: Story cards 3, 5, 7 and 11 each contain three sentences. Only the opening story card may exceed two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
